title: Fine Arts First Installment: Business Office Computation of the Plan Total and the First Payment, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Fees in the plan.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03 paying on the installment plan of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, each fee is the latest entry of its fee component on the participation's ledger by posted date, the one recorded first when two share that date: the participation fee, the travel fee and the concert attire package (the uniform package entry). Its net is that entry less the free-meal waiver, reduced-price meal waiver and household cap credits posted on it, never below 0.00. A component with no entry on the ledger has a net of 0.00.

**Plan total.** The plan total is the participation fee, the travel fee and the concert attire package net of credits, added together.

**First installment.** The first installment is the plan total divided by the Fine Arts Performing Ensemble number of installments in the payment terms table, rounded down to the cent.

**Order of assembly.** The amounts due up front are set aside from the plan total first, what remains is shared equally over the installments and rounded down to the cent, and the amounts due up front are then added to that share. Each amount due up front that is a percentage of a fee net is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

## Worked through (hypothetical ledger figures)

| Fee | Latest entry | Waiver and cap credits on it | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| participation fee | 72.00 | 36.00 | 36.00 |
| travel fee | 131.50 | 0.00 | 131.50 |
| concert attire package | 27.25 | 0.00 | 27.25 |
| plan total | | | 194.75 |

Shared over 3 installments: 194.75 divided by 3 is 64.9166..., rounded down to 64.91, the first installment.

*Order on hypothetical figures.* With 18.20 due up front out of the same plan total, 176.55 remains; divided by 3 that is 58.85; adding back 18.20 gives a first installment of 77.05.

A credit of any other kind on a fee (a billing correction, for instance) is not one of the credits that make up its net here.
